title: A Molty
description: molty.json: who a Molty is. Its body and its actions are in a file beside it (a .glb or .gltf from any 3D tool) or written out here by hand. Guide: docs/CREATURE.md. An action is picked up by its name: a mood plays the action of the same name, and so does a gesture.

$schema.description: Where this schema lives, for editors.

id.description: Its install id and file name.
id.errorMessage: must be 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -

name.description: Its name, as people see it.

version.description: X.Y.Z. Raise it when the built Molty changes.

about.description: One line for the catalog: what an agent says to offer it.
about.errorMessage: must be one line of 1 to 160 plain ASCII characters

look.description: How it looks, in a sentence or two, for the agent that speaks through it.
look.errorMessage: must be 1 to 240 plain ASCII characters

body.description: The body and its actions: the name of a .glb or .gltf file in this folder, or the body itself written here (bones, shapes, actions).
body.errorMessage: must be the name of a .glb or .gltf file in this folder, or the body written out: { bones, shapes, actions }

colors.description: Its colors by name. A shape says which one it wears.

poses.description: The ways it can hold itself, the one it starts in first: sit, stand, walk. Each rests in the action named <pose>_idle, or <pose>; the first one in idle. Left out: one pose, resting in idle. An action named <a>_to_<b> is the way from one to another; when there is one action that goes that way and nothing else plays it, it is found without the name.

moods.description: What it does in each mood, in words: idle, listening, thinking, speaking, happy, sleepy, surprised. A mood plays the action of the same name, in a loop. An action named <pose>_<mood> is its own way into that mood from that pose.

gestures.description: What it can do once when asked, in words. A gesture plays the action of the same name.

feet.description: The bones that touch the floor, so a planted foot stays put between two actions. The point is the bone's start, or the one the body gives it (foot).

center.description: Two bones the view stays between. Left out: the whole body's first bone.

blend.description: Seconds one action melts into the next. Default 0.3.

fps.description: Frames a second the actions are read at. Default 24.

name.errorMessage: must be a snake_case name: a lower-case letter, then up to 23 of a-z, 0-9 and _

line.description: One line, for the agent: what it does.
line.errorMessage: must be one line of 1 to 100 plain ASCII characters

plays.description: The action it plays, when it is not the one with its own name.

hold.description: For a gesture that plays a resting action (a walk): seconds it keeps it up before settling.

lasts.description: Seconds the whole gesture takes, when it is not its action's own length.

plays.errorMessage: is one line about what it does, or { about, plays, hold, lasts }

vec3.errorMessage: must be three numbers: [x, y, z]

bones.description: The skeleton, each bone after its parent. Units are the body's own (a cat stands about 0.6 high); y is up, it faces +z, its left is +x.

shapes.description: What is drawn: rounded shapes, each on a bone.

actions.description: What it can do, by name.

name.errorMessage: must be 1 to 24 of letters, digits, _ . and -

parent.description: The bone it hangs from. Left out: it stands on the floor by itself.

at.description: Where it starts, from its parent's start.

turn.description: Degrees about x, y and z.

foot.description: The point on it that touches the floor.

shape.description: blob: a soft ball that melts into the blobs next to it (the body). ellipsoid: a ball with three radii. capsule: a rounded stick from at to to. cylinder: the same with flat ends. cone: from at to its tip, flattened (an ear). patch: a region of color on the body, not a shape.

at.description: Its centre (its first end, for a capsule, a cylinder or a cone), from the bone's start.

to.description: Its other end, or a cone's tip.

turn.description: Degrees about x, y and z (a blob, an ellipsoid, a patch).

radii.description: A blob's, an ellipsoid's or a patch's three radii.

radius.description: A capsule's or a cylinder's radius at each end, or a cone's at its base.
radius.errorMessage: must be a number, or [at the first end, at the other]

flat_axis.description: A cone: the direction it is flattened along.

stiffness.description: A blob: how firmly it keeps its own shape. Default 2.

outline.description: Shapes with the same outline name are drawn as one outlined part.
outline.errorMessage: must be 1 to 24 of letters, digits, _ . and -

view.description: Where it is seen from: front (the default), side, three_quarter, or degrees.
view.errorMessage: must be front, side, three_quarter or degrees

follow.description: true: the view goes along with it (a walk).

stride.description: A walk: seconds a step takes, so it is joined and left on a step.

from.description: The pose it starts in. Left out: worked out from how it starts.

to.description: The pose it ends in. Left out: worked out from how it ends.

keys.description: Poses at moments: { time (seconds), <bone>: { at, turn, scale } }. Between two keys a bone moves in a straight line. A looping action ends on the pose it starts with.
